purpose: Example cloud-owned capacity pause schedule; never rely on a CLI process or browser remaining open
requiredModule: Az.Accounts; verify installed supported version before publishing/running
customRoleAssignmentScope: Only exact approved capacity ARM resource ID, supplied privately
roleValidation: If documented action-specific role is insufficient, stop for fresh permission approval; do not grant Contributor

schedule.startTime: Exact approved UTC deadline, not configured yet
schedule.expiryTime: Two hours after approved deadline: bounded retry window

spendingLimit: User-approved operational cap, not a guaranteed Azure billing stop. Shared overages and delayed billing are not yet measured.

teardown.fabricItems: Separate owned-item manifest and explicit cleanup approval

limitations: Creating an Azure Automation account is a mutation requiring explicit approval.
Managed identity, custom role, runbook and schedule are not provisioned by this example.
Dry-run checks target/read identity, not permission to execute suspend.
Runtime module availability and delegated deployment permissions require approved live validation.
